# Deckster

> Deckster runs creator (influencer) marketing campaigns for brands end to end. We match brands with creators using data, then handle planning, negotiation, content approvals, paid amplification, live tracking and final reporting under one roof.

## Pages

- [Home](https://deckster.live/): what Deckster does, use cases, results, how we work, FAQ and a brief form
- [About](https://deckster.live/about): the team and our approach
- [Careers](https://deckster.live/careers): life at Deckster and open roles
- [All openings](https://deckster.live/careers/openings)
